The '''Borlov system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borlov]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Borlovian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
